summary: Older installations finish moving to the current setup, and support access shows correctly.

fixes.title: Old collection jobs are removed
fixes.text: An update now removes the old single collection jobs left after the collection was split, once the new jobs have run.

fixes.title: Support access is shown correctly
fixes.text: An older installation now records which Invardia support app it trusts, so its support access shows correctly. Nothing about the app's access changes.

fixes.title: The web app keeps its name and address
fixes.text: The update no longer reports the web app's name as something to move.
